title: Stalled road construction on Thika Road
description: Road construction between Section 9 and Section 10 of Thika Superhighway has been stalled for over 4 months. The unfinished road surface is causing accidents during rush hours. Construction materials have been left scattered on the roadside, creating hazards for pedestrians and motorists.

title: Broken water main flooding school playground
department: Ministry of Water, Sanitation and Irrigation
description: A burst water main near Eldoret Primary School has been flooding the playground for three weeks. Children cannot access the sports field and the standing water is a health risk. The local water utility has not responded to three formal requests.

title: Delayed ID card issuance at Huduma Centre
department: Ministry of Interior and National Administration
description: Citizens in Mombasa have been waiting over 6 months for national ID cards. The Huduma Centre on Nkrumah Road is overwhelmed and staff say the system is down. Without an ID card, citizens cannot access government services, open bank accounts, or register for employment.

title: Frequent power blackouts affecting businesses
description: Kisumu CBD has been experiencing daily power outages lasting 6 to 12 hours for the past month. Small businesses are losing income and food storage at local markets is being damaged. KPLC has provided no schedule or explanation for the outages.

title: Overflowing garbage dump near residential estate
department: Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Forestry
description: The county dump site at Ruaka has not been cleared in two months. Garbage is overflowing onto the road and into the drainage channel. The smell is unbearable and residents fear a disease outbreak before the rainy season.

title: Maternity ward understaffed at county referral hospital
description: Nakuru Level 5 Hospital maternity ward has only two midwives covering 24-hour shifts. Expectant mothers are being turned away or waiting for hours without care. Three preventable complications were reported in September 2026 alone.

title: Illegal logging destroying Aberdare forest boundary
department: Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Forestry
description: Illegal loggers have been clearing trees along the Aberdare forest boundary in Murang'a for the past two months. Local farmers depend on this forest for watershed protection. The Kenya Forest Service has been notified but has not sent any rangers to investigate.

title: Public school classrooms in dangerous condition
department: Ministry of Lands, Public Works, Housing and Urban Development
description: Three classroom blocks at Machakos Primary School have large cracks in the walls and ceiling tiles are falling. Parents have raised the issue with the headteacher but repairs have not been authorised. The rainy season is approaching and the structures may not be safe.
